SQUAD GENERAL
.ACCEPT: Accepts a squad invitation. .DECLINE: Rejects a squad invitation. .DEMOTE (PLAYER): Demotes a player's squad rank. .LEAVE: Removes you from a squad. .INVITE (PLAYER): Invites named player to join your squad. .INVITES: Turns off and on your ability to recieve invites .PROMOTE (PLAYER): Promotes a player's squad rank. .RECRUIT (PLAYER): Invites named player to join your squad. .RECRUITING (ON / OFF): Toggles your ability to receive new recruits (note: squad recruiting must be enabled in the Squad tab). .WHO: Displays a list of all squad members online.
SQUAD LEADERSHIP
.CREATE: Allows creation of a new squad - NOTE - Must have 5 players to start new squad. .DISBAND: Disbands current squad (Restricted to CO only). .MAKECO (PLAYER): Makes the named player the Squad CO. .RESIGN: Squad CO resigns post. .VOTING: Enable or disable voting for the squad CO. .VOTECO (PLAYER): Allows Squad to vote for a new CO. .REMOVE (PLAYER): Removes a player from the squad
